Activation.manual: Manual (switch on from the HUD or on use)

Duration.turnStartTarget: Until the start of the target's next turn
Duration.turnEndTarget: Until the end of the target's next turn
Duration.turnStartSource: Until the start of the source's next turn
Duration.turnEndSource: Until the end of the source's next turn

Trigger.sourceTurnStart: At the start of the source's turn
Trigger.sourceTurnEnd: At the end of the source's turn

HUD.Title: Auras
HUD.NoAuras: This token has no auras yet.
HUD.InnerHint: Inner radius. Anything above 0 makes a donut that leaves this distance empty.
HUD.ItemAuras: Auras on this character's abilities and items
HUD.NotEquipped: Inactive: the item is not equipped.
HUD.OverrideNotice: All auras are forced to {shape} by the world setting.
HUD.ItemPickerHint: Auras on an ability, spell or item go wherever the character goes, in every scene.

Config.Title: Aura: {name}
Config.Name: Name
Config.ShapeHint: Circle draws a true radius. Grid spaces highlights the spaces within range, counted the way your scene counts diagonals.
Config.InnerRadiusHint: Leave at 0 for a solid aura. A value above 0 leaves that distance empty around the token, making a ring.
Config.MeasureFromHint: Circles only. Grid auras always count outward from the spaces the token occupies.
Config.WallsBlockHint: Clip the aura with movement-blocking walls, and don't affect tokens behind them.
Config.EnterOnAppear: Those inside when it switches on count as entering
Config.EnterOnAppearHint: When the aura appears or is switched on, creatures already inside get its "enters the aura" effects (a spell's area on casting, for example).
Config.ActivationHint: Passive auras are always on. Equipped auras switch off when the item is unequipped. Manual auras start off.
Config.EnableOnUseHint: Using the item (casting the spell, activating the feature) turns this aura on.
Config.EndWithConcentrationHint: Turn the aura off when concentration on this item ends.
Config.PresetItemHint: Used when this preset is attached to an ability or item.
Config.EffectsIntro: Effects are optional. An aura with no effects is purely visual. "@" values (e.g. @abilities.cha.mod, @attributes.spell.dc) are read from the aura's source.
Config.NoEffects: No effects: this aura is visual only.

Effect.Name: Effect name
Effect.ContinuousHint: Applied while a creature is inside and removed as soon as it leaves or the aura switches off.
Effect.TriggeredHint: Resolved each time one of the chosen moments happens, with an optional saving throw.
Effect.OncePerTurn: At most once per turn for each creature
Effect.ModifiersHint: Active Effect changes: attribute key, change type and value. Values may use dice (+1d4) and the source's data (@abilities.cha.mod).
Effect.Stacks: Stacks with the same effect from other sources

Presets.Title: Aura Library
Presets.Intro: Saved auras, including their effects. Add them to tokens from the Token HUD, to abilities and items from their sheets, or to every selected token from here.
Presets.RestoreHint: Re-add the presets that ship with the module (your own presets are kept).
Presets.RestoreConfirm: Re-add the module's default presets? Default presets you edited will be reset; presets you created are kept.
Presets.DeleteConfirm: Delete the preset {name}? Auras already on tokens and items are not affected.
Presets.ImportHint: Choose an exported .json file or paste its contents.

DocAuras.Title: Auras: {name}
DocAuras.Hint: Every token of a character that has this ability or item projects these auras.

Notify.OverrideActive: A world setting currently forces every aura to one shape.
Notify.InnerTooLarge: The donut hole must be smaller than the range.
Notify.SelectTokens: Select one or more tokens first.
Notify.BadJson: That is not valid preset JSON.
Notify.NoItems: This character has no items or abilities you can edit.
Notify.Migrated: Primal Auras carried over your auras, aura library and settings from Enhanced Token Auras.

Toggle.Name: Show / hide auras
Toggle.Hint: Toggle aura display for you only.

CycleShape.Name: Cycle aura shape override
CycleShape.Hint: GM: switch every aura between per-aura shape, all circles and all grid spaces.

Library.Name: Aura library
Library.Label: Open aura library
Library.Hint: Create, edit, import and export saved auras.

ShowAuras.Name: Show auras
ShowAuras.Hint: Draw auras on the canvas for you. Does not affect automation.

DefaultShape.Name: Default shape for new auras
DefaultShape.Hint: Each aura can still be switched from the Token HUD.

ShapeOverride.Name: Force aura shape
ShapeOverride.Hint: Draw and evaluate every aura as a circle or as grid spaces, e.g. per table or per scene type. Gridless scenes always use circles.

TargetInclusion.Name: A creature is inside an aura when
TargetInclusion.any: Any part of its space is inside

PassThrough.Name: Moving through an aura counts as entering it
PassThrough.Hint: A creature that passes through an aura during a move, and ends it outside, gets the aura's "Enters the aura" effects (then its "Leaves the aura" ones). The same for creatures an aura passes over as its source moves. "Once per turn" still applies. Teleporting doesn't count.

ConsiderElevation.Name: Account for elevation
ConsiderElevation.Hint: Creatures whose elevation differs from the source by more than the aura's range are not inside it.

Automation.Name: Automate aura effects
Automation.Hint: Apply saves, damage, healing, conditions and modifiers from auras. Runs on the GM's client; a GM must be connected.

IgnoreDefeated.Name: Ignore defeated tokens
IgnoreDefeated.Hint: Defeated tokens neither project auras nor are affected by them.

PlayerSaves.Name: Players roll their own saves
PlayerSaves.Hint: Ask the owning player to roll aura saving throws. The GM rolls if they don't answer in time.

SaveTimeout.Name: Player save timeout (seconds)
SaveTimeout.Hint: How long to wait for a player's saving throw before the GM rolls it.

AutoExpire.Name: Expire timed aura effects
AutoExpire.Hint: Remove conditions and modifiers from triggered effects when their duration ends.

ChatMode.Name: Aura chat cards
ChatMode.Hint: Who sees the summary card posted when a triggered effect resolves.

GenericSave.Name: Saving throw formula (other systems)
GenericSave.Hint: Used outside D&D 5e and PF2e. {ability} is replaced with the ability chosen on the effect.

GenericHp.Name: Hit point path (other systems)
GenericHp.Hint: Used outside D&D 5e for damage and healing.
